stat_guide_body: HP (+5 per point) Max health. More HP = more hits survived. ATK (+1 per point) Attack damage per hit. DEF (+1 per point) Directly reduces incoming damage (at least 15% gets through). AGI (+1 per point) Crit: AGI×0.15% Dodge: AGI×0.01% Crit Dmg: 1.5× + AGI×0.075% Combo: AGI×0.025% (extra hit chance) Reduced by monster resistance. LUC (+1 per point) Dodge: LUC×0.025% Gold: LUC×0.1% Combo: LUC×0.012% Drop Rate: +LUC×0.0004% (capped)

notice_launch_body:
Thank you for playing Infinite Loot-Loop.

In this release:
• The full route — Grassland, Forest, Volcano, Desert and the Underwater depths
• 25 bosses to hunt down
• Characters to collect, each with their own bonuses
• An item collection that grants permanent stats as it fills
• Achievements, leaderboards and cloud save

More is on the way. See you in the loop.
notice_hardmode_body:
Hard Mode is open.

Every region returns with tougher monsters, and the whole route can be run again at a higher tier.

• 20 Hard bosses, each with its own reward
• A full tier of Hard equipment
• Clear all 20 to unlock the Oracle

Hard Mode unlocks after you clear the normal route. Deaths cost more here — bring gear.
notice_worldgate_body:
The World Gate is open.

Four regions lie beyond it — Japan, Greece, the Military Zone and Heaven — each with its own monsters, gear and boss.

• 5 new bosses, ending with Archangel Sovereign
• A new tier of equipment in every region
• Heaven climbs through nine zones, each tougher than the last

The Gate opens once you have cleared all 20 route bosses in Hard Mode. Good luck.
notice_balance_204_body:
Thank you for playing — and for the reports that made this update.

• Leaderboard scores display correctly again. Very large scores were being shown as unreadable text.
• World Gate Hard Mode has been re-checked from end to end and rebalanced. Critical hits and dodge now tighten as you go deeper, so Greece, the Military Zone and Heaven are the step up they were always meant to be.

COMING NEXT — THE MAZE
A new Normal Mode chapter is planned for early to mid September. It opens in the Maze and continues through three more regions: Ice, America and the Amazon.

Thank you for playing.
notice_wg_hard_202_title: v2.0.2 — World Gate Hard Mode Open
notice_wg_hard_202_body:
World Gate Hard Mode is open.

All nineteen maps return at a higher tier — Japan, Greece, the Military Zone and Heaven.

• A full tier of Hard gear in every region
• World Gate boss accessories are a real power boost — and a well-timed revive is your key to claiming them
• Archangel Sovereign returns as a real fight, not an endurance test

It opens once you have defeated all five World Gate bosses in Normal Mode. Good luck.
notice_wg_balance_201_body:
World Gate normal mode is being rebalanced in version 2.0.1.

• Each region's gear now climbs steadily, so every map is worth farming
• Monster rewards ascend properly across the whole route
• Boss difficulty adjusted, including Archangel Sovereign

World Gate HARD MODE is planned for release this weekend. Thank you for playing.
